updates.title: Rules page and settings
body: A Rules and how it works page (the ? button, the gear menu, or /rules.html): controls, glass, scoring, tears, Power Paddle, comeback rules, difficulty, modes and tips.

Basic settings: difficulty, mode, score to win, time limit, master/effects/ambience volume, mute, fog quality, reduce motion, control hints, wind gauge, on-screen buttons and left-handed layout, reset to defaults. The panel pauses the game while open.

updates.title: The deep shaft
body: The arena now falls down a layered deep shaft: parallax structure, depth markers, debris, light shafts, wind gusts and buffeting.
Fog is now a shader pushed by the wind, the fall, the arena and impacts.
Power Paddle: unlock it with tears, activate with E or the POWER button; every third hit is a boosted strike.
Comeback rules: 4 down wakes your paddle until you lead by 2; 6 down gives the NPC the paddle for good. Perk: TheGreatsAreNeverForgotten.
Glass cracks branch from every impact, stay part of the pane, and shatter along the cracks.
Background eyes are dim and glow when their wall eye is hit; halfway through, they give way to one huge eye that pairs with a wall eye.
Whistling wind ambience, placeholder pong blips and a layered glass-break sound.
Reduce Motion setting.

updates.title: Physics feel pass
body: Thrust: Space or double-tap lunges your paddle and hands its speed to the ball.
Arena sways and tilts with impacts; wind blows the tears; the fall eases and surges.
Slice tears like fruit (mouse drag or touch swipe); tears are bigger and slower.
Plain walls no longer open eyes or drop tears; background eyes start closed and react.
Fog, falling parallax and speed streaks.
Procedural sound: falling air, eye squish, glass, thrust. M mutes.
Four NPC difficulties (Chill by default) and an easier start.
Settings button: difficulty, mode, volume.
